original_test_intent: Validate the specified USB 2.0 transport carries MCTP between the intended controller and management endpoint, preserving endpoint identity and returning approved request/response traffic without USB resets, protocol errors or management-path disruption.
original_method: Obtain the signed MODS module/recipe and bind the physical/logical USB controller, hub/port, VID:PID/interface/driver and MCTP binding/EIDs; preserve USB/MCTP/BMC state; execute a bounded read-only or explicitly approved non-state-changing message matrix; capture USB traces/counters and decoded MCTP headers/completion; verify the same endpoints remain enumerated and management access stays healthy; stop on reset storms, endpoint loss, unexpected state-changing opcode or BMC instability.
manual_activity: A platform-management owner approves the endpoint/message scope and maintains an independent management recovery path while the vendor module runs.
required_inputs: MODS package/module version/hash/signature/license and supported platform/OS
Exact USB2 controller/root-port/hub/connector/endpoint route, VID:PID, interface and driver
MCTP binding, local/remote EIDs, message types/opcodes/payloads, timeouts and expected responses
Management-path impact, prohibited state-changing/reset/firmware actions, error limits and recovery
safety_requirements: Do not run while procedure/criteria, USB route or EIDs are TBD
Verify MODS message scope contains no unapproved write, reset, firmware or provisioning action
Preserve USB/MCTP/BMC/kernel logs and management reachability
Stop on wrong endpoint/EID, unexpected opcode, repeated USB reset, timeout/error burst, device loss or BMC instability
Do not retry protocol messages or reset endpoints automatically
agent_execution_scope: Validate package, transport identity, EID/message matrix and non-mutating semantics
Collect baseline and, after explicit approval, full MODS/USB/MCTP request-response evidence
Monitor endpoint enumeration and management health without verdict
Do not invent messages, change firmware/state, reset devices, clear logs or recover autonomously
engineer_actions: Approve MODS USB2.0 MCTP module and complete topology/EID/message oracle
Approve any mutation boundary, timeouts/error limits and independent recovery
Review decoded transactions and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: `mods -h` establishes only binary presence and its malformed/truncated SSH output is not USB2.0 MCTP evidence. The exact vendor module and safe message contract are mandatory.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After package/topology/EID checks and explicit confirmation, run the exact approved MODS USB2.0 MCTP module once and preserve complete request/response, transport and endpoint-health evidence.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM PACKAGE-GATED USB2 MCTP TRANSPORT AND ENDPOINT VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one vendor-approved bounded message matrix tied to a fully identified USB path and MCTP endpoint pair, with decoded responses and reset/error monitoring.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical/logical transport identity, EIDs, safe message semantics, response oracle, management protection and recovery decisions without inventing TBD details.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: MODS availability or USB enumeration does not prove MCTP binding, endpoint identity or correct request/response behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: MCTP tooling can address the wrong EID or issue vendor commands with side effects; USB resets may disrupt BMC/management paths even when the host survives.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must state whether the endpoint is a BMC, GPU/DPU, NIC or other management controller and whether USB is the native MCTP binding or a vendor bridge; that determines EID ownership, allowed messages and recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, approval and MODS package/module/recipe identity
USB controller/root-port/hub/port/connector plus endpoint VID:PID/interface/driver mapping
MCTP binding, EID discovery/assignment provenance and approved message matrix
Full timestamped MODS stdout/stderr/exit status and decoded request/response/completion data
Pre/post USB topology/reset/error counters and MCTP/BMC/kernel/SEL health

review_improvement: Makes the TBD vendor test transport-, endpoint- and message-specific while protecting the management path and preserving decoded transaction evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: MCTP success cannot be inferred from a USB device appearing or a vendor binary loading. The management endpoint must be bound through the USB route and EID, then exercised with known message semantics. Because vendor modules may include reset or write actions, the recipe requires opcode-level approval. A reset storm or wrong EID can disrupt management access, so transactions are bounded, logs preserved and no automatic retry/recovery is allowed.
